Name: Marnie's Auto-Petters
Author: Damentia
Description:
A quick and simple Content Patcher mod

﻿None of the existing Auto-Petter mods were updated yet and I prefer not to have to sell my soul to Joja or bumble around in Skull Cavern.

So Marnie will now sell Auto-Petters after the Community Centre is completed. I made the default price 75 000, more than Joja sells it for, but you can edit the price in the config file if you so wish.

To install simply extract the zip into your mods folder.

Requires:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
There is also an optional version that will send a mail the day after the Community Centre's Completion similar to the Auto-Grabber mail. For a little extra immersion. This version additionally requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url].

[i][b]Version 1.0.1
[/b][/i]
This was a small update that added the update keys to the manifest files to﻿﻿ prevent SMAPI from telling users that the mod doesn't have update keys.
